project_source_policy.snapshot_semantics: Uploaded Project Sources do not automatically synchronize with local files.
project_source_policy.replacement_rule: Replace every changed source in the Project and regenerate this manifest.
project_source_policy.self_hash_rule: This manifest does not contain its own SHA-256 because a self-hash would be recursive.

sources.purpose: Workflow state machine and review loop.
Specification version, freeze state, approval, and source bindings.
Original goal, scope, constraints, invariants, and deliverables.
Project Source inventory, versions, and upload verification.

human_verification_checklist: Verified by the human project owner.
The frozen TMQA specification version is 0.2.0.
The requirements, acceptance matrix, verification plan, and source manifest versions and hashes were accepted for use as the Project Sources baseline.
Any later source replacement requires refreshed hashes and renewed human verification.
